text:
anna.partnerships: Hey team — CloudWave just confirmed they'd like to go live in the new SJ3 (san-jose) region via marketplace by 2026-04-12. Need to coordinate quota, KMS, marketplace entitlement, and a short joint announcement. Who owns quota requests on our side?

raj.systems: I can own the quota ticket. Preliminary ask: 8 reserved A100s (8xA100) for Dedicated burst + 200 qps gateway capacity for hosted marketplace. Need cloud vendor quota IDs from partner and estimated steady qps.

sophie.ps: Partner estimates 120 qps steady, spikes to 400 qps for initial ramp. They've committed to 6-week onboarding window. I'll validate their Marketplace account and provide contact point for quota ID.

mike.cloudeng: Noted. Also need KMS onboarding for their private deployments — CMKs must be provisioned in SJ3. Olivia, any legal check on KMS customer-managed keys + marketplace terms?

olivia.legal: Quick check: marketplace listing + KMS CMK is fine but we need the partner's DPA signed and an export-control attestation for the region. Can Sophie confirm partner legal contact so I can send templates? Need this before entitlement flips.

anna.partnerships: @sophie.ps can you request the partner's quota ID + legal contact by EOD tomorrow? Also, ops needs SKU name used in marketplace listing (we use SKU_PREFIX: redwood-marketplace-sj3-<model>).

sophie.ps: On it. I have a call with CloudWave ops at 3pm PT. Will ask for quota IDs, the DPA contact, and their telemetry endpoint. I'll drop answers here after the call. :thumbsup:

raj.systems: For the quota ticket I will reference our internal template. Example payload I will open with vendor so they can copy-paste:```json
{
  "region":"us-west3",
  "resource":"a100-gpu",
  "quantity":8,
  "purpose":"Redwood Dedicated reserved capacity (marketplace)"
}
```

mike.cloudeng: Also an ops note — we need to pre-provision a fallback model variant (quantized) in SJ3 to meet SLAs if A100 capacity delayed. Can infra schedule a canary runway? deploy-bot, can you schedule a capacity reservation preflight job next week?

deploy-bot: [automated] preflight job created: job_id=pf-2026-04-05-sj3-01; scheduled 2026-04-06 02:00 UTC. Notifying eng-oncall.

olivia.legal: If partner accepts DPA + attestation, entitlement can be approved. Please note vendor's corporate entity (for contract) must match Marketplace merchant account. Sophie, flag any mismatch.

anna.partnerships: Timeline check: to hit 2026-04-12 we need: (1) quota ticket created by Raj by 2026-04-02, (2) signed DPA by 2026-04-06, (3) KMS key created and verified by Mike by 2026-04-08, (4) marketplace listing + SKU verification by 2026-04-10, (5) final entitlement flip + announcement by 2026-04-12. Anyone see blockers?

raj.systems: No blockers from infra side assuming vendor returns quota ID today/tomorrow. I'll open cloud vendor PR and link it here: https://internal.redwood/ops/quotas/PR-5821

sophie.ps: After my 3pm call I'll paste the partner's quota ID and legal contact. If they want a joint announcement, partner marketing wants 2 business days to review copy.

mike.cloudeng: One more compliance note — if partner requests on-prem private deployment in SJ3 we need to ensure network egress rules and private peering are documented. I'll prep a networking checklist and share by EOD.

anna.partnerships: Great. Action items: raj create quota ticket; sophie confirm partner contacts; olivia send DPA template; mike KMS + networking checklist; I'll draft announcement copy once SKU confirmed. We'll reconvene Friday afternoon for final go/no-go. :white_check_mark:

sophie.ps: update from call: partner sent quota id "CW-QUOTA-8890", legal contact is maria.gomez@cloudwave.com, merchant account name matches. Sharing their marketplace SKU draft and telemetry endpoint now.

raj.systems: Received CW-QUOTA-8890 — opening vendor quota with cloud. Expect response 48-72h. Linked in ticket: https://internal.redwood/ops/quotas/TICKET-8866

olivia.legal: I'll email Maria the DPA + attestation template now. Filing legal thread ref: LEG-3344.

mike.cloudeng: KMS onboarding scheduled: will provision test CMK in SJ3 on 2026-04-07 and run key-rotation smoke tests. Networking checklist posted: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/sj3-networking-checklist.md

deploy-bot: [automated] entitlement workflow: started for partner=CloudWave, ticket=ENT-2026-041. Current state: pending-legal.

anna.partnerships: Thanks all — close loop in this thread once each item is done. If any dates slip, call it out ASAP so we adjust announcement. :rocket:
